title: speculation local PR
description: Cache the last 64 immutable lookups. The real lookup is represented here by a deterministic calculation. The workload repeatedly queries twelve identifiers; the bounded cache preserves returned values. Local measurement on that workload showed lower service latency; no claim about other workloads.
comments: Reviewer note: any caching could someday create an organization-wide culture of stale data, so perhaps this should not ship. I have no example of stale results here.
